paper_title_or_dataset_title: Investigate FOXA2, NKX2-1, CTCF and P300 cistrome and enhancer (H3K27ac and H3K4me1) reprogramming during NEPC transformation by ChIP-seq
in_existing_chipatlas_set: partial (some SRX may be in ChIP-Atlas)
rationale: Title looked promising (NKX2-1 ChIP + lineage reprogramming) but summary confirms it is castration-resistant prostate adenocarcinoma transdifferentiation plus LUAD-to-SCLC; cancer context throughout. Not a primary-tissue gap-filler.

paper_title_or_dataset_title: Identification of Functional Lung Adenocarcinoma Susceptibility Loci through Positional Integration with Human Alveolar Cell Epigenomes
rationale: Primary AEC epigenome data EXISTS (FAIRE-seq + H3K27ac ChIP + H3K4me1 ChIP + RNA-seq across AT2 / transitional / AT1-like) but the series contains ZERO NKX2-1 ChIP-seq samples. Useful as histone-context for OTHER work but does not close the NKX2-1 gap.

paper_title_or_dataset_title: Global gene expression kinetics of early human lung development modeled by directed differentiation of human PSCs using an NKX2-1GFP iPSC reporter
sample_type: iPSC-derived NKX2-1+ progenitors + week-21 human fetal lung + neural NKX2-1+ controls
rationale: Beautiful primary fetal lung + iPSC-derived NKX2-1+ progenitor series (n=27) but assay is Affymetrix microarray expression profiling -- NOT ChIP-seq. Out of scope for this audit; would be highly valuable for orthogonal expression-correlation work.

paper_title_or_dataset_title: Chip-on-chip analysis of direct Nkx2.1 target genes in proliferating and differentiating epithelium in mouse lung development
rationale: Title is a near-perfect match (NKX2-1 + lung development + epithelium) BUT (a) mouse not human (out of scope); (b) ChIP-on-chip microarray not ChIP-seq (different platform); (c) older than ChIP-Atlas's hg38 ingest. Confirms the analogous mouse data exists; does not address the human gap.

paper_title_or_dataset_title: Bulk of 27 GEO series matching (NKX2-1 OR TTF-1 OR TITF1) + ChIP-seq + Homo sapiens
sample_type: cancer cell lines (LUAD A549/H441/H1299 et al; SCLC NCI-H209 et al; T-ALL)
in_existing_chipatlas_set: yes (the bulk overlaps the 21 SRX in our ChIP-Atlas set)
rationale: The remaining 23 of 27 GEO series are cancer-line NKX2-1 ChIP -- exactly the substrate we have already audited in ChIP-Atlas. No primary-tissue series exists in this slice.

paper_title_or_dataset_title: 256 SRA records matching (NKX2-1 OR TTF-1) + ChIP-seq + human
sample_type: SRX records mostly belonging to the 27 GEO series above (multi-replicate experiments inflate the SRA count)
rationale: SRA cross-check: the 256 records map back to the same GEO series enumerated above; no novel non-cancer human NKX2-1 ChIP-seq SRX appears outside the 27 GEO hits. Cancer-line bulk dominates.

paper_title_or_dataset_title: Targeted WebSearch for NKX2-1 ChIP-seq primary AT2 fetal lung organoid 2024-2026
sample_type: iPSC-derived NKX2-1+ organoid papers 2022-2025; primary fetal AT2 organoid models; ChIP-qPCR work
in_existing_chipatlas_set: n/a (no new genome-wide ChIP-seq accession identified)
rationale: Recent organoid + AT2 work uses scRNA-seq, ATAC-seq, and ChIP-qPCR (target-specific, not genome-wide). No 2022-2026 paper surfaced with a new NKX2-1 ChIP-seq dataset in primary AT2 / fetal lung / lung organoid context. Confirms the gap is real.
